name: Awesome Trading Agents
summary: Curated list of open-source LLM trading agents, MCP servers and agent skills for market research, strategy and execution.
description: An awesome list of open-source projects where LLMs research markets, make trading decisions or connect agents to market data and execution tooling. Entries are grouped into Agents (multi-agent systems, single-agent traders, research copilots, real-money experiments, prediction-market specialists, benchmarks, strategy coding), MCPs (market data, brokerage and exchange trading, research tools, TradingView bridge, prediction markets, backtesting) and Skills (equity research, crypto/DeFi, strategy coding, brokerage execution), plus papers and learning resources.
contains: Agents: multi-agent systems, single-agent traders, research copilots, benchmarks
MCPs: market data, brokerage/exchange, research tools, TradingView bridge
Skills: equity research, crypto/DeFi, strategy coding, brokerage execution
entry criteria: public code, LLM-driven behavior, recent activity, docs, adoption
